method: Approximate correlation groups: disjoint first-update anchored 100-second windows and group signature sets; per update highest-weight matching training group. Greedy per-prefix all-or-none VP selection aims for training recall >=94%. Actual and predicted records are matched one-to-one by identical VP/path/communities and timestamps within 100s; duplicate predictions at identical timestamps collapse. Unseen test VPs are retained by default. IPv4 announcement records only; no withdrawals, cross-prefix stage, anchors, or full GILL.
